Resolves #18981

Related: #18762 · #18837

🪢 *Every tracked cell-editing arm edits a flat string in a plain column. A field inside a nested object and a cell that holds a tree component are code paths of their own, and both work — now something says so.*

## What changes

Test-only.

- New fixture `test/playwright/component/apps/grid-cell-editing-record-shapes`: one grid over a model with a nested `user` object (modified fields tracked and highlighted), one grid over a `TreeStore` with an editable `tree` column.
- New `e2e/grid/CellEditingRecordShapes.spec.mjs`, five arms on the shared `e2e/utils/gridCellEditing.mjs` reads.

Evidence: L3 (real Chromium, CI-executed e2e tier) → L3 required (AC-1…AC-4). Residual: none.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; the PR baseline jobs run in CI. Change class: test-only (`test`).

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `a nested field commits on Enter, and is marked modified exactly while it differs from its original` and `Tab commits a nested field into the next one, and Escape there keeps its value`. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `renaming a node puts the new name inside its tree component` and `a folder's label selects and edits like any cell, and the node stays as it was`. |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: `collapsing the parent by its toggle commits the child's draft`. |
| AC-4 | Outside CI: the mutation matrix below. CI-covered: the spec sits in `test/playwright/e2e/grid`, a `RUN_PATHS` entry of `buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs`. |

## Deltas from ticket

- The folder arm also clicks the label once before the double-click: a toggle widened to the whole cell flips twice under a double-click and ends where it began, so only the single click shows it.

## Test Evidence

Mutation matrix against `dev@bd2a404560` (each source restored afterwards):

| Mutant | Arms red |
|---|---|
| M1 `CellEditing#completeEdit` writes the leaf name instead of the path | both nested arms |
| M2 `grid.Row` asks `isModifiedField` for the root object | the Enter arm (the untouched sibling gets marked) |
| M3 `grid.column.Tree#applyRecordConfigs` passes no `value` | the three tree arms |
| M4 the tree component's toggle delegate widened to the whole cell | the folder arm |
| M5 `CellEditing#onEditorFocusLeave` cancels instead of committing | the collapse arm |

`--repeat-each=10`: 50 of 50.
